Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Heidi from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, but do not worry, we will do our best to help you.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Please measure the voltage of the +BAT- terminals (11# and 12#) on the control board to see whether it is above 22VDC. If the voltage is below 22VDC, please check whether the output voltage of the adapter is 36VDC. If so, disconnect the batteries from the control board and measure the output voltage of the batteries to see whether it is above 22VDC. If the voltage of the batteries is also below 22VDC, please keep the batteries charged fully to try it again. If it still cannot work, please check the batteries. Kindly note that a 24V 12Ah battery (or 2pcs 12V batteries connected in series may function as 24V) is required to power the gate opener. Marine or Automotive type battery is compatible.

2. If the voltage is above 22VDC, please disconnect all accessories from the control board first (just leave the power source and the arm). And disable the photocell function by turning the dip switch #3 off. Then erase all remotes codes from the control board and reprogram them to have a try. If it fails, please instantaneously short (plug the wire in, then pull it out immediately) the push button terminals (4# and 5#) to check whether the opener can work. How to instantaneously short the “O/S/C COM” terminals: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VdDhyHZxmpQE5pG7BYHOJi5GYb7iZHFS/view?usp=sharing

3. If there is still no luck, please release the clutches on the arm and push the gate to the middle position firstly. And engage the clutches and press the remote to see whether the gate can run towards the both directions. If it still doesn’t help, please check the motor. Connect the red & black wires of the arm to the DC 24V power source directly, the motor should run, and then exchange the polarity of the wires, the motor should run in the opposite direction. If the motor runs in both directions, the motor itself is good.

4. If the motor is good, please disconnect the BLUE, GREEN & YELLOW wires of the faulty arm from the control board, use two jumper wires to short the ULT, COM & DLT terminals to which the wires were connected, and then press the remote to see if the opener can run. If so, the limit switch in the arm may be faulty.

Please let me know the result one by one.

Videos showing the problem and pictures of the whole control board are much appreciated for further judgement. You can directly send the video to my E-mail via the attachment. If the sending is not successful, please share the photo or video link through dropbox, icloud or google drive. Thanks for your understanding and cooperation.

And also please reply your specific SHIPPING ADDRESS with zip code and confirm PHONE # available for further assistance. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty.

Thank you again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Heidi
TOPENS Customer Service Team

Checked with our engineer, please find the breakdown of the differences and our recommendations below.

1. Model Comparison: The AT1202, AT602, A8132, and KD702 are all dual swing gate opener kits. The primary difference lies in the motor type and power. The AT602 and AT1202 use electromechanical arm actuators, while the A8132 and KD702 use articulated arm actuators. For light gates like yours (20-30kg and 3m each), any of these models are strong enough, but the AT1202 features a faster opening speed and a more robust motor for heavier or more frequent use. The KD702 is a highly popular model for lightweight residential gates due to its ease of installation.

2. M12 Remote Control Programming: The included M12 remote controls can be independently programmed. You can program a button to open a single gate, and another button to open both gates. Therefore, you can easily program two remotes for your neighbors to operate only their gate, and six remotes for yourself with a button for your gate and another button to open both simultaneously if needed.

3. TC196 WIFI Remote: The TC196 can be wired to control one or both gates depending on how you set the DIP switches on the control board. By setting DIP switch #3 to ON, you can configure the operator for single-gate control, or set it to OFF so one signal opens both gates sequentially. You will have full control over this during setup.

4. TC175P and TC148 Accessories: Your plan to use the TC175P wired touch panels (external) and TC148 rocker switches (internal) is fully compatible with all the dual kits mentioned. results.raw_email: what is the difference between A8132 PW802 AD8 AT1202
results.generated_reply_en:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Joyce from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I understand you’d like to know the differences between the A8132, PW802, AD8, and AT1202 gate opener models. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty, and I’m happy to explain.

The A8132, PW802, and AD8 models share the same A8 arm and an energy-saving control board. The AT1202 uses a different AT12 arm and a standard control board with a digital display. All four models use 80W motors.

The main distinction is in their power supply methods:

1. **A8132**: Ships with the UPS01 power adapter, which supports AC power, backup battery, and up to a 20W solar panel. This is best if you want a versatile, energy-saving system with solar options.

2. **AD8**: Designed primarily for battery power. An AC power adapter (DPS180-U or UPS01) must be purchased separately. Ideal for fully off-grid setups.

3. **PW802**: Includes the DPS180-U AC direct power adapter. This model is very economical if you have reliable AC power at the gate, as it does not support direct battery or solar connection through the included adapter.

4. **AT1202**: Has a built-in transformer for AC power. Battery backup is possible but only as a secondary feature. The digital display is convenient for settings and diagnostics.

If you are in the US and plan to use only AC power, I would recommend the PW802 or AT1202 for their similar price points, with the PW802 being particularly energy-saving.

If you have further details about your gate size, weight, and available power source, I can give you a more tailored suggestion. Please feel free to share photos or your installation plan. Thank you once again for considering TOPENS! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for.

Best regards,
Joyce
TOPENS Customer Service Team

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Joyce from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused, but do not worry, we will do our best to help you. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Check all the wires are connected as they should be. Then please measure the voltage of the +BAT- terminals (11# and 12#) on the control board to see whether it is above 22V. If the voltage is below 22V, please disconnect the batteries from the control board and measure the output voltage of the batteries to see whether it is above DC 22V. If the voltage of the batteries is also below 22V, please keep the batteries charged fully to try it again. Also check whether the output voltage of the adapter is 36VDC.

2. If the voltage of terminals 11# and 12# is above 22V, please check whether the power LED on the control board is ON (blinks twice per second). If it is off, check the fuse to see whether it was burnt out and replace the fuse if necessary. There is a backup fuse packed within the user manual pack. The fuse type is Ø5*20mm 5A 250VAC fast blow glass fuse.

3. If it still cannot work, please check the batteries. Kindly note that a 24V 12Ah battery (or 2pcs 12V batteries connected in series may function as 24V) is required to power the gate opener. Marine or Automotive type battery is compatible.

Looking forward to the result after you finish the troubleshooting.

Please let me know the result one by one.

Also kindly reply with your specific SHIPPING ADDRESS with zip code and confirm a PHONE # available for further assistance. Additionally, please provide a video or photos of the control board showing the wiring and LED status so we can better diagnose the issue.

Thank you again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Joyce
TOPENS Customer Service Team

1. Since you mentioned turning the force down, please adjust the stall force after powering off the system first. Turn the FORCE potentiometer on the control board clockwise to increase it, then power the system back on and allow the opener to complete one full operating cycle to see if the binding improves.

2. It sounds like the gate opens too far and binds. If you are using Pull-to-Open Installation Mode, the open position is determined by the gate bracket. Please check if the moving rod is properly retracted when your gate is at the desired open position. If not, adjust the gate bracket inward a little and test again.

3. If you are using Push-to-Open Installation Mode, the open position is adjusted by Limit Switch B. Adjust Limit Switch B inward on the arm, then press the remote to open the gate and see if the open position changes correctly.

4. Regarding the remote not picking up, please clear all remote codes first, then try reprogramming the remotes. Are all the remotes the original M12 remotes included with our system?

Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Heidi from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused, but do not worry, we will do our best to help you.

Yes, a pull-to-open installation does make a difference—thank you for confirming. In pull-to-open mode, the open position is determined by the gate bracket, not the limit switch, so we can focus on that.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Power off the system, turn the FORCE potentiometer clockwise to increase the stall force to max. Then turn on the power and operate the gate opener to run for a complete opening & closing cycle. See whether the gate will open and close normally in the next opening and closing cycle.

2. For pull-to-open installation, the open position is determined by the gate bracket. Please check if the moving rod is properly retracted when your gate is at the desired open position. If the rod is over-retracted and binding, adjust the gate bracket inward a little so the gate stops at the correct open position without bouncing back.

3. If the issue is still unresolved, please use the release key to disengage the clutches of both arms, and check whether the gate itself can be manually opened & closed freely 3.3 feet (one meter) away from the gate hinge. If not, please let me know the weight and length of your gate and double check the gate to make sure it can run freely by hand.

4. If the above step is fine, please take down the arm from the gate and hold its front mount with a hand. Then press the remote to see if the arm can extend and retract properly each time without stopping or reversing.

Please let me know the result one by one. Videos showing the problem and pictures of the whole control board are much appreciated for further judgement. You can directly send the video to my email via the attachment. If the sending is not successful, please share the photo or video link through dropbox, icloud or google drive. Also please reply with your specific SHIPPING ADDRESS with zip code and confirm your PHONE # available for further assistance if needed.
